8395723

Hi all,

  please review this fix to a potential underflow of some statistics counters in `G1MonotonicArena`; the interleaving described in the CR causes underflow, giving large values for the two counters.

The fix is to make sure that that interleaving can't happen: before we snapshot and update the counters, drain all executions of get().

Testing: gha

Thanks,
  Thomas
